mapper.select: SELECT M.user_id AS "loginId", M.pswd AS "loginPw", M.athrty_cd AS "role", M.sys_id AS "sysId", IFNULL(A.athrty_level, 99) AS "athrtyLevel", M2.resign_dt AS "resignDt" FROM tn_mem_m001 M LEFT JOIN tn_ath_a001 A ON M.sys_id = A.sys_id AND M.athrty_cd = A.athrty_com_cd LEFT JOIN tn_mem_m002 M2 ON M.idx = M2.user_idx WHERE M.user_id = #{loginId}
SELECT user_id AS "loginId", user_pw AS "loginPw" FROM TN_USR_M001 WHERE user_id = #{loginId} AND use_yn = 'Y' AND del_yn = 'N'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TN_ATH_M001 A JOIN TN_MNU_M001 M ON A.sys_id = M.sys_id AND A.menu_id = M.menu_id WHERE A.athrty_com_cd = #{role} AND M.sys_sect_cd = 'MG' AND A.menu_show_yn = 'Y' AND A.use_yn = 'Y' AND M.use_yn = 'Y' AND M.del_yn = 'N'
SELECT menu_id AS "menuId", sensitive_yn AS "sensitiveYn" FROM TN_MNU_M001 WHERE sys_id = #{sysId} AND menu_id = #{menuId} AND use_yn = 'Y' AND del_yn = 'N' LIMIT 1

SELECT menu_show_yn AS "menuShowYn", inqire_yn AS "inqireYn", rgst_yn AS "rgstYn", mdfcn_yn AS "mdfcnYn", del_yn AS "delYn" FROM TN_ATH_M001 WHERE sys_id = #{sysId} AND athrty_com_cd = #{athrtyComCd} AND menu_id = #{menuId} AND use_yn = 'Y'
SELECT service_endde FROM TN_SYS_M001 WHERE sys_id = #{sysId}
